entries.title: Crewmates on your other computers use your knowledge
entries.body: A crewmate whose task runs on another computer, or as another user on this Mac, now reads your saved knowledge and saves a source you asked it to keep, as a crewmate here does. It is shown the same matching entries when it starts, gets its project's directions on every turn, and what it relied on shows on its task.
entries.noPicture: What changes is what a crewmate on another computer reads and records; the knowledge views on this Mac look as they did.
